# Cross-domain operation catalog

<!-- Generated by tools/coverage.py. Edit mathematics-coverage.json instead. -->

Includes same-carrier operations to make all signature families comparable. Domains with the same Java class can have different mathematical membership. A result labeled LIST has finite ordered sequence semantics with duplicates; a solution family is a single mathematical object, not an eager list.

| boundary value problem solution | PDE x BoundaryConditions ~> SolutionFamily | Scoped library / proposal | PARTIAL | SOLUTION_FAMILY | CATALOG_ONLY | Function spaces and boundary regularity required | No implementation |
| conditional distribution | Distribution(X) x Condition ~> Distribution(X) | Scoped library / proposal | PARTIAL | SCALAR | CATALOG_ONLY | Zero-probability/general conditional laws require appropriate hypotheses | No implementation |
| curl in oriented Euclidean three-space | VectorField^1(R^3) -> VectorField(R^3) | Scoped library / proposal | TOTAL | SCALAR | CATALOG_ONLY | Three-dimensional oriented Euclidean convention | No implementation |
| differentiation of C1 functions | C^1(I,R) -> C^0(I,R) | Scoped library / proposal | TOTAL | SCALAR | CATALOG_ONLY | Requires differentiability evidence; no arbitrary callback accepted | No implementation |
| divergence | VectorField^1(U) -> C^0(U,R) | Scoped library / proposal | TOTAL | SCALAR | CATALOG_ONLY | Regularity and dimension required | No implementation |
| fundamental group | PointedTopologicalSpace -> Group | Scoped library / proposal | TOTAL | SCALAR | CATALOG_ONLY | Base point and homotopy classes matter; not a point-set enumeration | No implementation |

| general function evaluation | Function(A,B) x A -> B | Scoped library / proposal | TOTAL | SCALAR | CATALOG_ONLY | General total function spaces require totality and extensionality contracts | No implementation |

A catalog signature is a proposed mathematical contract. It does not assert an available solver, decidable membership, existence of a result, uniqueness, or complete enumeration. See each record's required_extension and invariants in the JSON registry.

See [the operation model](MATHEMATICAL_OPERATION_MODEL.md) for native execution, composition, failures and the optional prototype.
